description: For moving a venue from another system. Shows how many members, packs, bookings and check-ins were imported (and how many exist in total). Imports never email anyone, and re-running with the same external_id values does not create duplicates. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.
